content.short: Hyper Ninja is a P2E action RPG on Injective where players manage warriors and dojos for on-chain rewards.
content.description:
Hyper Ninja is a ninja-themed play-to-earn action RPG built natively on the Injective blockchain. The game blends resource gathering, crystal refining, and clan-building mechanics, allowing players to recruit warriors and manage spirit energy to grow their personal dojos. By engaging in competitive combat and strategic management, users can earn on-chain rewards within a transparent and decentralized ecosystem.

Designed to leverage Injective's high-speed infrastructure, Hyper Ninja provides a seamless gaming experience with true digital ownership of in-game assets. The project aims to foster a strong community of players and creators, bridging the gap between traditional gaming mechanics and the innovative rewards of the Web3 landscape.
